verdict.rationale: Sill's own site says it is free and open source. Its public GitHub repository documents building the app from source with SwiftPM, running the host via `swift run`, and nightly builds made from the code, so the source is clearly readable. However, no evidence names the specific open license or its terms, so the 'open license' part of the story rests only on the general 'open source' claim. Missing for 10: a named license (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier) and its terms, plus independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Sill is free and open source.
and you can also build it from source (below).
`swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line
every night the code changes, a notarized Sill for Mac built from it goes to the [nightly pre-release](https://github.com/Saffsanity/sill/releases/tag/nightly) on GitHub.
